name: gemini-cli
description: Google Gemini CLI subscription access — OAuth + Code Assist project discovery. Auto-staged into every install.

oauth.label: Gemini CLI (Google)
oauth.description: Gemini CLI / Code Assist OAuth — Authorization Code + PKCE. After login the harness calls :loadCodeAssist (with the gemini-cli fingerprint) to provision a cloudaicompanionProject, then sends chat through the prod Code Assist gateway.
